markers.name: Totford Volcano
markers.note: Erupting volcano. Height: 2704m.

markers.name: Nyirna Hot Springs
markers.note: A geothermal springs with naturally heated water that provide relaxation and medicinal benefits. Average temperature is 28°C.

markers.name: Freidualvei Spring of Youth
markers.note: This legendary water source is whispered about in ancient tales and believed to possess mystical properties. The spring emanates crystal-clear water, shimmering with an otherworldly iridescence that sparkles even in the dimmest light.

markers.name: Mevecsalas — coal mining town
markers.note: Mevecsalas is a mining town of 10879 people just nearby the coal mine.

markers.name: Riravoruche Bridge
markers.note: A stone bridge spans over the Riravoruche River near Barta.

markers.name: The Grey Jackal
markers.note: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious fried garlic with red brandy is served here.

markers.name: The Honest Tavern
markers.note: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious braised deer with blue mead is served here.

markers.name: Poncosingalese Lighthouse
markers.note: A lighthouse to serve as a beacon for ships in the open sea.

markers.name: Hajhezokoroks Battlefield
markers.note:
A historical battle of the Plapolis Rebellion. 
Date: March 16, 1229 Shoverden Era.

markers.name: Olhal Monster
markers.note: Locals say a relic monster of 6 m long inhabits Olhal Lake. Truth or lie, folks are afraid to fish in the lake.

markers.name: Horvirares Monster
markers.note: Elders say a relic monster of 20 m long inhabits Horvirares Lake. Truth or lie, folks are afraid to fish in the lake.

markers.name: Knamer Monster
markers.note: Old sailors tell stories of a gigantic sea monster inhabiting these dangerous waters. Rumors say it can be 33 m long.

markers.name: Forval Beast
markers.note: Tipplers speak of a feared Beast who inhabits Forval hills and steals cattle at night.

markers.name: Firas Forest

markers.name: Petimpore Forest

markers.name: Floliba Forest

markers.name: Dezoczigetmik Pinery

markers.name: Ruined Settlement

markers.name: Funteiro Library
markers.note: A vast collection of knowledge, including many rare and ancient tomes.

markers.name: Travelling Incomprehensible Circus
markers.note: Roll up, roll up, this incomprehensible circus is here for a limited time only.

markers.name: Mouroso Competition
markers.note: Warriors from around the land gather for a competition of brutality in Mouroso, with fame, fortune and favour on offer to the victor.

markers.name: Minor Jetty
markers.note: A small location along the Carzuera River to launch boats from sits here, along with a weary looking owner, willing to sell passage along the river.

markers.name: Geese migration
markers.note: A huge group of geese are migrating, whether part of their annual routine, or something more extraordinary.

markers.name: Sobradoutim Cavern
markers.note: The Sobradoutim Cavern. Locals claim that it is a good spot to hid treasure.

markers.name: Framping Crypt
markers.note: A desolate necropolis where an eerie stillness reigns. Time seems frozen amidst the decaying mausoleums, and the silence is broken only by the whispers of the wind and the rustle of tattered banners.
